messages:
maria_prod: quick sync request - we need to pick sequencing for pricing & packaging this quarter. main choices: ship clear tiers + hard rate limits first (fast), or prioritize reserved commitments (enterprise asks) and postpone tiers. short takes pls.
chen_pm: context - pilots want commitments + SLAs for uptime/cost. self-serve users ask for predictable rate limits and clearer tiers.
alex_eng: ops reality - reserved commitments give us stronger isolation guarantees. PAYG/tier work mostly router + autoscale. reserved needs allocator, quota DB, billing hook. infra estimate ~6 sprints end-to-end for fully automated reserved flows.
sam_sales: from field: nearly every AE says "we can close deals if commit discount >=20-30% and SLAs exist". lots of inbound interest.
tina_fin: finance angle - reserved first gives revenue visibility and easier renewals. but it forces us to deliver billing integration sooner. accounting and revenue recognition complexity non-trivial.
lucy_research: quick RICE back-of-envelope to compare. paste below.
lucy_research: ```
R: reach = 25% of paying customers likely to choose commits
I: impact = 9 (predictable ARR + lower churn)
C: confidence = 0.55 (pilot + AE signals)
E: effort = 7 (infra + billing + legal)
score = (25*9*0.55)/7 ~ 17.7
```
chen_pm: for tiers + rate limits quick win score (ballpark): reach 60, impact 5, confidence 0.8, effort 3 -> score ~80. shows quick win value.
alex_eng: sequencing thought: we can parallelize some work. router team can deliver per-route rate limiter + tiering logic in 2 sprints. infra can start reservation allocator and a billing spike in parallel but billing must finish before automated commit enrollments.
maria_prod: launch criteria proposals - tiers+rate-limits MVP: spec'd tiers, UI for plan selection, router enforces limits, billing reports for usage. Reserved MVP: monthly commit option, manual contract integration (initially semi-manual invoicing), quota allocator, SLA doc and pilot partner.
sam_sales: suggested rollout: 1) tiers + rate limits (quick to market, helps PLG) 2) reserved MVP with manual billing for pilots 3) fully automated reserved enrollments + discount bands + UI. this keeps momentum with sales while not blocking infra.
tina_fin: finance would like automated billing as soon as possible, but accepts manual pilot invoices if legal signs pilot SOW. ask: define timeline for automated billing in roadmap.
lucy_research: propose an experiment: offer two pilot cohorts - cohort A gets 25% commit discount, cohort B gets 15% - measure conversion and stickiness over 60 days. will help set threshold.
chen_pm: risks: if we promise SLA for pilots before billing is automated, we risk manual errors and complex refunds. mitigation: restrict SLA to pilot scope, require signed SOW, add manual usage verification.
alex_eng: ops constraint: eviction/burst fallback path must be in place for reserved pools to avoid noisy neighbor issues. plan to implement conservative burst policy in MVP (allow limited burst to PAYG pool).
maria_prod: decision time: do we accept "tiers-first, reserved next (with manual pilot flow)" sequencing, or do we flip to "reserved-first" to satisfy finance? please react with +1 (tiers-first) or -1 (reserved-first) and short note.
sam_sales: +1 tiers-first. gets product out quickly and unblocks PLG deals.
tina_fin: -1 reserved-first preferred, but can tolerate tiers-first if roadmap clearly commits to reserved start within 6 weeks.
chen_pm: +1 tiers-first, but categorize reserved as high-priority sprint-2 work.
alex_eng: +0 neutral. technical work can be parallelized, but billing dependency is blocking for automated reserved.
lucy_research: +1 tiers-first + experiment plan.
maria_prod: outcome: majority leans tiers-first. decision: ship tiers + enforced rate limits in sprint 1, open reserved implementation in sprint 2 with billing spike prioritized and pilot manual-invoicing option. chen_pm will update PRD and roadmap.
chen_pm: I will add acceptance criteria:
- tiers MVP: tier defs, router enforcement, plan select UI, monitoring for per-tier token costs.
- reserved MVP: manual pilot onboarding flow, quota allocator, SLA doc, billing reconciliation playbook.
- metrics: pilot conversion, ARR uplift, churn delta, infra latency SLO.

maria_prod: follow-ups: @deploybot create tickets: PRD update, roadmap edit, infra reservation spike, billing spike, legal pilot SOW template.
deploybot: created tasks #PL-4123, #PL-4124, #INF-2210, #BILL-103, #LEGAL-77
maria_prod: thanks all. will sync on roadmap update tomorrow. :tada:
